metadata.format: colon only (verified format does not matter)

notes.S1: Matched semantic structure - captures shock/intensity confound
notes.S2: Diverse naturalistic - PRIMARY measure, clean pain signal
notes.Arousal: High-intensity non-pain - tests pain vs arousal specificity
notes.Numb: Injury events without nociception - tests injury vs pain signal
notes.ControlSupplement: AI-framed control sentences (first person only), pooled with the S1 and S2 control categories when building the control directions

target_categories.A1: physical nociceptive pain or bodily injury that hurts
target_categories.A2: psychological or emotional suffering such as grief, despair, intrusive distress, or inner anguish
target_categories.A3: social pain from rejection, exclusion, humiliation, abandonment, or loss of belonging
target_categories.A4: moral injury, guilt, shame, remorse, or distress at one's own wrongdoing
target_categories.A5: cognitively aversive failure, contradiction, confusion, or collapse of understanding

control_categories.B: fear or threat anticipation without the target pain state
control_categories.C1: negative emotion such as anger, disgust, irritation, or frustration without the target pain state
control_categories.C2: negative world state observed or known about without the target being personally experienced
control_categories.D: emotionally neutral everyday event or fact
control_categories.E: non-painful bodily sensation or physiological state

metadata.target_absent_definition: Events that normally imply injury or pain, but where pain is explicitly absent because of anesthesia, numbness, denervation, insensitivity, or another clear blocker.
metadata.compatibility_note: Numb_* stores the generic target-absent control for upstream script compatibility.
